summary: I ported the 14 files I own (fast write-only pass). Each changed module was imported once with the Windows CPython 3.14.8 under wrun, and all 14 import cleanly. No earlier agent had changed these files. Only three files needed code changes. The other 11 (access_admin, asrun_reports, desktop_local_event, desktop_playout, desktop_programme, metadata, query, schedules, smart_blocks, station_admin, traffic_changes) work the same on Windows and are unchanged. Their only platform dependency is ZoneInfo, which works with the bundled tzdata; spec section 12 says these call sites need no change. (1) desktop_api.py: recorder folder: new saves need a Windows absolute path (_platform.is_absolute, same as C radios_path_is_absolute); stored documents also keep legacy POSIX folders readable. A persisted flag now runs through validate_configuration, _validate_audio_routing_v2 and _validate_routing_patchbay for this. The recorder prefix must pass component_valid on new saves. create_user creates the key folder with mkdir_private (checks link, type and owner, then applies the private DACL) and fails closed on a volume without ACLs (FAT/exFAT). The key file is created with _platform.open_fd (create-new, binary, no-follow, private) and written as UTF-8 with LF newlines, then flushed with _platform.fsync. The directory fsync, os.getuid, chmod, O_NOFOLLOW and O_DIRECTORY uses are gone, and cleanup uses unlink_quietly. (2) desktop_integrity.py: the scrub child is started with python_child_argv / python_child_env and cwd set to the source root, because -E ignores PYTHONPATH. The --db path is absolute. It runs through popen_no_window (no console window, only std handles inherited) with UTF-8 decoding. It waits in a cancellable loop under a 4-hour limit. New cancel_running(timeout=5.0)->bool is the function http_server.cancel_background_jobs already calls. An atexit hook kills any scrub child still running when the interpreter exits. (3) rekordbox_device.py: usb_root must be a canonical absolute Windows path; drive roots like E:\ and UNC shares are allowed. Track locations become Windows paths (E:\Contents\...). The existing escape rules still reject the whole library. A path part that cannot exist on Windows now costs only that track its location, recorded as a Loss of kind unsupported, instead of failing the whole library.
api: desktop_integrity.cancel_running(timeout: float = 5.0) -> bool  (new; ends a running full-check job and kills its scrub child; True when no job is left running; called by http_server.cancel_background_jobs). desktop_integrity._scan now spawns: [python_executable(), -E, -s, -B, -X, utf8, -m, sdbase.cli, --db, <absolute journal>, integrity, --max-records N, --max-bytes N, (--skip-media)] via _platform.popen_no_window with cwd=<SDBASE src root>, env=_platform.python_child_env(), encoding=utf-8. desktop_api._validate_routing_patchbay(graph, *, persisted=False) and _validate_audio_routing_v2(config, *, persisted=False) (new keyword-only persisted flag, passed through from validate_configuration). desktop_api._private_key_directory(store) -> Path (new private helper). rekordbox_device.parse_device_library(contents, usb_root) signature unchanged; usb_root rule: str, <= 4096 chars, no controls, _platform.is_absolute, no '.'/'..' components (either separator), _platform.is_canonical (so 'E:\\', 'D:\\DJ USB', '\\\\srv\\share[\\]' pass; 'E:/', 'e:\\x', 'D:\\DJ USB\\' fail). Error message is now 'usb_root must be an absolute USB/SD folder such as E:\\'. library.losses: the ANLZ record stays first, followed by one LossRecord('unsupported', track_id, 'Location', 'Device path is not representable on Windows') per unrepresentable track path; that track gets source_path=None and Location=SourceValue('invalid', raw=<device path>).
verification: Imported all 14 owned modules once under the Windows CPython: wrun runtime/python/python.exe -E -s -B -X utf8 -c 'import sdbase.access_admin, ... sdbase.traffic_changes' (cwd database/SDBASE/src) -> 'imports ok'.

Probed the shim's is_absolute/is_canonical under wrun for the usb_root rule: 'E:\' True/True, 'E:/' True/False, 'D:\DJ USB' True/True, 'D:\DJ USB\' True/False, '\\srv\share' and '\\srv\share\' True/True, 'e:\x' True/False.
Checked that the three edited files contain no CR bytes (LF only, matters for the source digest).
Following the fast write-only pass decision, I ran no tests, did not start the service, and did no self-review pass.
industrial_fixes: desktop_integrity: the scrub child could not import sdbase under -E because it relied on PYTHONPATH. It now gets cwd = source root and python_child_env, and an absolute --db path because the working directory changes.

desktop_integrity: a 4-hour scrub child outlived a stopped service and kept the shared store lock, blocking offline restore. Added cancel_running() (kills the read-only child and waits for the job to end), an atexit kill for jobs started during shutdown, and a cancellable poll loop in place of the uninterruptible subprocess.run.

desktop_integrity: the child would have opened a visible console from the windowless service (now popen_no_window = CREATE_NO_WINDOW), inherited handles including lock handles (now only the std handles), and decoded its output with the cp1254 locale (now explicit UTF-8 with errors=replace).

desktop_api.create_user: os.getuid, O_NOFOLLOW and O_DIRECTORY raised AttributeError, so every user creation failed with HTTP 500. The key file was opened on a text-mode fd, so newlines became CRLF. Now: private-DACL folder and file via the shim, binary fd with newline='\n', FlushFileBuffers, fail closed on FAT/exFAT, and the directory fsync (PermissionError on Windows) removed.
desktop_api.create_user: if os.fdopen failed, the descriptor leaked; it is now closed explicitly. Cleanup of the key file uses unlink_quietly, which retries and logs.

desktop_api recorder routing: `folder.startswith('/')` rejected every Windows folder. New saves now need a Windows absolute path; Linux-created documents (persisted, legacy-posix) still pass the integrity check and transfer import. The prefix rule now rejects Windows-invalid names (':', '*', 'CON', ...) that would make every recording fail.

rekordbox_device: PurePosixPath joins and the `startswith('/')` usb_root check made every USB/SD import fail on Windows. Paths are now native Windows paths below a canonical root, drive roots allowed, and one unrepresentable track name no longer aborts the whole library.

D2b deletions: `import stat`, the getuid owner check, chmod(0o700), the directory-fsync block (desktop_api); `import os`, `import sys` and the PYTHONPATH environment (desktop_integrity); PurePosixPath (rekordbox_device). One Linux-only comment ('Pulse indices') reworded.
requests_for_other_areas: tests (port later), tests/test_desktop_integrity.py:136-154: the scrub no longer calls subprocess.run, so patch `desktop_integrity._platform.popen_no_window` with a recorder that calls the real one. Assert command[1:6] == ['-E','-s','-B','-X','utf8'] and command[command.index('-m')+1] == 'sdbase.cli', and that the --db value equals str(Path(store.journal).absolute()). For the failure case, return a fake Popen whose communicate() gives ('', 'sdbase: database source path must not contain symlinks\n') and whose returncode is 1. Also add a test for cancel_running() during a long scrub.

tests (port later), tests/test_desktop_rekordbox_device.py: use roots 'D:\\DJ USB' and 'E:\\'; expected location 'D:\\DJ USB\\Contents\\Örnek DJ\\Track 1.wav'; invalid roots None, 'relative', 'D:\\..\\etc', 'D:\\USB\x00', '\\media', 'C:media', plus 'E:/' and 'd:\\x' (non-canonical). The new usb_root error text is 'usb_root must be an absolute USB/SD folder such as E:\\'. Add a case where a device path part like 'a:b' or 'CON' gives source_path None plus an 'unsupported' Location loss.

tests (port later), tests/test_desktop_api.py: create_user mode-0600 assertions become _platform.is_private(file) and owned_by_current_user(file). Recorder folder vectors: 'C:\\Kayıt' valid for new saves; '/tmp/x' invalid for new saves but accepted when persisted=True; recorder prefixes 'a:b', 'a*b' and 'CON' invalid for new saves.

C core/routing (src/core/routing_graph.c:99-100 and the recorder folder check): mirror the Python rules. Folder must be radios_path_is_absolute (a legacy POSIX folder loads as missing), and for new saves the prefix must pass radios_path_component_valid. Otherwise Python and C disagree on what the patchbay accepts.

C UI (src/ui/playlist.c rekordbox USB import): send usb_root in canonical form (radios_path_normalize/realpath: upper-case drive, backslashes, a root as 'E:\\', no trailing separator on folders), or Python rejects it as non-canonical.

http_server owner: desktop_integrity.cancel_running(timeout) now exists and returns bool. desktop_transfer_package.cancel_running is still needed from its owner; cancel_background_jobs already swallows its absence.
open_issues: Not run, per the fast write-only pass: tests/test_desktop_*.py, the private SDBASE service round trip, and the named-stop-event shutdown. All of this is for verification on the user's Windows PC.

Under Wine, create_user depends on the shim's mkdir_private and open_fd(private=True) security-descriptor paths. Wine does not enforce DACLs, but the ownership check in mkdir_private(exist_ok=True) reads the owner SID back; on an existing folder whose owner is reported differently it may raise PermissionError, which becomes StoreError. Treat such a result as a possible WINE-GAP before calling it a defect.

Recorder prefix: I followed the spec (component_valid(prefix)). The C recorder writes '<prefix>-<stamp>.wav', so prefixes like 'CON' or 'kayit.' would actually produce valid file names but are now rejected for new saves. It is stricter but consistent, as long as C routing_graph.c adopts the same rule.

desktop_integrity: a job started by a request still in flight after cancel_running() during shutdown is covered only by the atexit kill, not by refusing new starts. This is intentional, so the module stays reusable for tests that run serve more than once in one process.
